headline: Six Sectors Surge as Bases Flip
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the front has sharpened dramatically. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest flashpoint, recording 40 ownership changes in the past 24 hours and a fresh surge of 10 502 Colonial and 11 208 Warden casualties while enlistments hold steady. Mooring County matches that tempo with 34 flips and a 24‑hour toll of 10 964 Colonial and 10 653 Warden dead, its troop flow still climbing. Stlican Shelf adds 14 flips centred on Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, pushing totals to 59 983 Colonial and 67 158 Warden losses. Stonecradle also logs 14 changes around The Reach, World’s End and Buckler Sound, now at 61 649 Colonial and 78 801 Warden casualties. Palantine Berm erupts with eight new flips in the last six hours — the first notable activity there this war — driving its count to 3 169 Colonial and 3 993 Warden. Farranac Coast, Linn Mercy and Nevish Line each register three flips, while the northern Warden‑held rear areas and most Colonial‑only regions stay quiet with no ownership changes reported.
